title: Eyewitness accounts of Nazi nuclear tests

tellings.quote: reaction. And then there's a second eyewitness account of of um what appears to be a nuclear test near the Theian forest

plain: In 1944 and 1945, what looked like a Nazi nuclear test is said to have been seen near the Thuringian forest in Germany, by a second eyewitness after an earlier account of a similar reaction. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, drawing on the writers Plimpton Hydrick and Farrell and on a book called Critical Mass. If true, it would mean Nazi Germany got far closer to an atomic bomb than is usually believed.
